_about: Standard operating procedures for running the STARTEND portfolio service. Rendered into sop-k4x9m2.html at every boot by boot/views_boot.py. Operational only — strategy and decisions stay in claude.ai. No URLs that act as write keys: those live in the Railway / n8n environment and are named here, never pasted.

sops.title: Redeploy the HQ views (hq.startend.ch)
sops.when: After every merge to main that touches boot/ or boot/data/
steps: Merge the pull request to main. Railway fetches boot/views_boot.py from main on every boot, so nothing is built from a branch.
Trigger the portfolio redeploy: n8n webhook `redeploy-portfolio` (URL in the n8n workflow, not in this repo) or Railway → startend → portfolio → Redeploy.
Read the deploy log. Every view prints one line: `boot5 ok <KEY> <FILE> <BYTES>`. A `boot5 FAIL` line names what did not render; `boot5 WARN … dropped external link` is informational.
Open https://hq.startend.ch/ptf-k4x9m2.html on a phone. The live counter must show N/25 and the stamp must carry today's `board built` time.
Run `python3 scripts/publish_verify.py --live https://hq.startend.ch` from main: it compares the sha256 of the repo-rendered views with what is served.

sops.title: Move an initiative (LIVE counter, stage, next, owner, blocker)
sops.when: The moment a stage changes or a blocker appears or clears
steps: Edit `boot/data/checklist.json` in a pull request. Allowed stages: spec, build, sell, live, paused. Allowed owners: MARCIN, CLAUDE_CLAUDECODE, GPT_CURSOR, GROK_MARKET.
Set `live: true` only when a stranger can reach the public page and pay the CHF 1 test. That flag is the N in N/25 — nothing else counts.
Add a `marcin` object (`action`, `link`) when the next step is one click that only Marcin can make. It lands in the click queue on NEXT and SOP.
CI validates the file (`tests/test_board_compose.py`) and re-renders the board with Lighthouse ≥ 90. Merge, then follow «Redeploy the HQ views».

sops.title: Add an HQ view
sops.when: A new initiative gets a SPEC page or an ops page
steps: Canon-backed page: append `("KEY_HTML", "name-k4x9m2.html")` to `CANON_VIEWS` in boot/views_boot.py. The highest canon `version` wins at boot.
Repo-backed page: drop the HTML in `boot/pages/` and append it to `REPO_VIEWS`. Runtime URLs go through `PLACEHOLDERS` and the Railway environment, never into the file.
Composed page (canon content plus a live layer): add a composer to `COMPOSERS` and register it in `COMPOSED_VIEWS`; the canon body must be carried over unchanged.
Add a fixture under `ci/fixtures/<KEY>.html` when the page needs realistic content for Lighthouse, and add its URL to the Lighthouse step in .github/workflows/quality.yml.
Merge, redeploy, check the `boot5 ok` line for the new key.

sops.title: Write a canon page safely (read → insert → re-read → prune)
sops.when: Any script that changes BOARD_HTML, NEXT_HTML or a SPEC page in canon
steps: Read the key immediately before writing and take the highest `version`. Never write from a copy that is minutes old.
Insert `version + 1` with a `note` and `updated_by`. The content must contain a durable marker so a rerun is a no-op.
Re-read at once. If two rows share the new version, re-apply your transform on the other writer's row, insert again, delete your orphan.
Prune to the three newest rows. Then trigger «Redeploy the HQ views» and verify the marker on the live page.
Reference implementation: boot/canon_patch_chamdigital_rollout_20260830.py. CANON_RW_URL is a write key: environment only.

sops.title: Prove a door is payable: the CHF 1 test, then the refund
sops.when: Before an initiative is flipped to live, and after every checkout change
steps: Open the door as a stranger (private window, phone). You must understand the offer within 10 seconds; if not, that is the first fix.
Click the CHF 1 test button. Stripe Checkout opens in test mode (`STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` starts with `sk_test_`). Pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date, any CVC.
You must land on the success page with the reference shown, and the confirmation email must arrive.
Refund: Stripe dashboard → Payments → the CHF 1.00 payment → Refund → full amount. Under 30 seconds.
Check the order row (n8n data table, or the HQ Mail for ORIGICAST) and the `checkout.session.completed` delivery in Stripe → Developers → Webhooks. Then set `live: true` in the checklist.

sops.title: Wire error alerts to the Engine Error Alerts workflow
sops.when: Every new public service, before it goes live
steps: Set `ERROR_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL` on the Railway service to the webhook of n8n workflow «Engine Error Alerts» (id N6gYXlzZUn6OXOs4). The URL is a write key: environment only.
The app posts one JSON message per unhandled 5xx: `{service, path, method, error, ts}`. Nothing personal is sent.
Test: call a route that raises in a test deployment and confirm the diagnosis email arrives.
`GET /healthz` must answer 200 without touching the database; `GET /health` additionally checks Postgres. Railway's health check points at /health.

sops.title: Reconnect Google Sheets for X Autopilot
sops.when: The HQ Mail «Sheets reconnect» email arrives
steps: Open the reconnect link from the email (it carries the operator key from `GOOGLE_SHEETS_RECONNECT_KEY`).
Grant access with the Google account that owns the spreadsheet in `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`.
Copy the refresh token shown into `GOOGLE_SHEETS_REFRESH_TOKEN` on the Railway service and redeploy.
Open the panel once to confirm the sheet renders.

sops.title: Manual outreach (restaurants, sponsors)
steps: Manual and individual only — no automated cold outreach in CH, AT or DE.
Restaurants: docs/ZRH_R_OUTREACH.md, five mails per slot, each with the demo link /apps/demo.
Sponsors: docs/SPONSOR_DE.md or docs/SPONSOR_PL.md, run the five-point pre-send checklist in the document.
Log every reply on the checklist row (`next`), never in a side spreadsheet.
